```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Gviz)
library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(Rsamtools)
```

# Input Files

```{r}
bam_file <- "sample.sorted.bam"

# Gene annotation
gtf_file <- "genes.gtf"

# Region of interest
chrom <- "chr1"
start_pos <- 100000
end_pos <- 101000

genome_build <- "hg38"
```

# Import Gene Models

```{r}
gtf <- import(gtf_file)
```

# Genome Browser

```{r fig.width=15, fig.height=8}

# Genome axis
axis_track <- GenomeAxisTrack()

# Gene annotation track
gene_track <- GeneRegionTrack(
    gtf,
    genome = genome_build,
    chromosome = chrom,
    name = "Genes",
    transcriptAnnotation = "gene",
    fill = "darkgreen",
    col = "darkgreen",
    background.title = "darkgreen",
    col.title = "white"
)

# Coverage track from BAM
cov_track <- DataTrack(
    range = bam_file,
    genome = genome_build,
    chromosome = chrom,
    type = "histogram",
    window = -1,
    name = "Coverage",
    fill.histogram = "steelblue",
    col.histogram = "steelblue",
    background.title = "steelblue4",
    col.title = "white"
)

# Read alignments (nucleotide resolution)
align_track <- AlignmentsTrack(
    range = bam_file,
    genome = genome_build,
    chromosome = chrom,
    isPaired = TRUE,
    name = "Reads",
    background.title = "black",
    col.title = "white"
)

# Plot all tracks together
plotTracks(
    list(
        axis_track,
        gene_track,
        cov_track,
        align_track
    ),
    from = start_pos,
    to = end_pos,
    chromosome = chrom,
    collapseTranscripts = "longest",
    stacking = "dense",
    fontsize = 12
)
```

sessionInfo()
